review.source_gold_method: Manual judgments from original raw source/contract bytes and explicit profile bindings; stdlib byte lookup only computes selected physical slices. No compiler, product import, extraction or comparison.

range_convention.bytes: zero-based half-open UTF-8 byte offsets in exact original bytes
range_convention.lines: one-based; end_line contains the last included byte
range_convention.declarations: match the shared structural declaration range: include enclosing TypeScript export modifier; exclude trailing newline; witnesses retain exact original source bytes

standards_source_review.scope: Pinned 3.1.0 operationId scoped within API document; local operation/component references. No OpenAPI completeness validation claimed.
proto3 syntax/package/message/RPC source declarations. Protobuf package never establishes a language implementation binding. No compiler validation claimed.

admission: Owner context explicitly enrolls a finite relative profile path/digest and external reviewed-source receipt. Self-declared review, compiler validation or generated provenance in repository files is not authority.

Read profile, original contract artifacts and endpoint source through the one held SourceRoot and admitted inventory. Refuse escapes, absolute paths, symlinks, duplicate IDs/fields, nonfinite numbers, oversized/invalid schema and conflicting service roots.
Profile shape is finite JSON. Each admitted service ID has one registered source-prefix/root scope; every binding declaration and source witness lies within its service scope.

Contract identities include contract-owner service, namespace, protocol and operation/topic plus request/response/event schema. HTTP additionally records method/path/document operationRef; RPC records package and RPC service. Queue namespace/topic equality alone cannot cross service owners.

Every positive relation requires both explicit endpoint roles/service IDs, exact profile source row, original contract operation/schema witnesses, source binding witnesses, matching identity and exactly one complete existing structural declaration with exact source digest/range/name affinity.
Manual reviewed original protobuf source witnesses are imported; no general protobuf parser, compiler, generated-stub inference, project build, runtime discovery or executable hook is introduced.

Unknown artifact provenance, stale digest, partial source, duplicate endpoint, missing/computed route/service/topic, mismatched namespace/schema/operation or absent endpoint yields a source-backed unknown boundary with zero exact targets.
A reviewed profile is input evidence, never a special fixture digest recognizer or general claim of source/deployment completeness. Review-only candidates cannot become asserted targets.
Ordinary lexical calls/references/imports keep their own evidence kinds; contract links cannot promote a dynamic transport call to a lexical call target.
source_admission.mutation_context: Each independent phase captures consumer revision as result_inventory_sha256 and enrolled profile digest as its current frozen bytes. External review must cover each changed profile before producer admission. Original artifact/source expected digests are never automatically renewed from current files. after_sha256 values are byte-only fixture inputs, never production identity recognizers.
source_admission.unknown_origin_policy: If the source origin itself is stale/missing/partial, anchor the observable unknown to the current admitted profile row, with candidate original path/expected digest retained separately. Never present stale source offsets or bytes as current physical evidence; zero exact target and source affinity unqualified.
source_admission.invalidation: Observe every profile/config, positive and negative contract path, endpoint source/declaration, service scope and schema lookup as shared dependencies. Profile/artifact/source/config add/edit/delete/rename changes participate in identity and invalidation; rebuild closure if unknown.

query_protocol.row_unit: one physical origin contract interaction or empty-target boundary; repeated targets never deduplicate distinct origins
query_protocol.default_rows: all admitted resolved interactions and source-backed unknown boundaries; unbound lookalike contributes zero contract rows

questions.question: Can both endpoints, scoped identity, original schema/operation and explicit binding evidence be explained from exact source slices?
questions.expected: Exactly the frozen target for each; no cross-service HTTP join; distinct protocol family; no runtime order claim.

questions.question: Do each rejected candidate and the unbound lookalike keep their independently frozen negative meaning?
questions.expected: One unknown row and zero exact targets for each rejected explicit profile origin; zero contract rows for unbound lookalike; duplicate candidates stay review-only.

questions.question: Do independently frozen mutations/restorations invalidate unchanged consumers and match a clean rebuild of identical bytes?
questions.expected: Full normalized facts, boundaries, dependencies, paged query rows and excerpts agree; source digests/ranges/identity/targets/certainty are never normalized away.

questions.question: Does one-origin-per-page union match the complete bounded result without duplicate/lost rows or missing empty-target boundaries?
questions.expected: Stable union includes every admitted origin and boundary; known hidden counts or explicit lower-bound/unknown knowledge; changed service/protocol/filter/snapshot, foreign and expired cursors rejected; held generations never mix.

questions.question: Do each small edge/entity/work/response/excerpt/file/profile limit and cancellation stop bounded work visibly?
questions.expected: No fabricated completeness or scan after response truncation; roots/witnesses/profile seeds charge existing admission/handoff/index/query bounds; failed refresh rolls back coherently.

questions.question: Does mapping import only reviewed captured artifacts while project build/compiler/generator/provider commands are forbidden?
questions.expected: Owned recorder/traps report zero project command/build/compiler/generator/provider invocations; permitted parser worker/Git observation is recorded distinctly. Source mapping never executes profile strings or repository configuration.

structural_ownership: shared resolver and configuration/source dependency observation
ceilings: Input/key preparation only; independent source review pending; no producer admitted, extraction, comparison or accepted T020 proof.

Finite opt-in manually reviewed original OpenAPI/proto/queue/service bindings only; arbitrary schema references, general protobuf imports/options/code generation and deployment discovery remain unqualified.
Runtime transport, active deployment, execution ordering, service discovery, completeness and optional third-party engines remain unqualified.
Static contract relationships and explicit unknown boundaries remain distinct from lexical call/import evidence.
